findings.defect: Python equality accepted True==1 and False==0 in semantic flags.
findings.fix: Separate Python/NumPy boolean semantics from numeric metrics. Reject boolean/numeric substitutions; retain existing numeric tolerances.

findings.area: dynamic skim references in rollback diagnostics
findings.defect: True could pass as numeric epoch 1 and disappear during execution-ID normalization.
findings.fix: Validate top-level, classification, component and gate references using equality plus the existing canonical epoch hash before normalization. Reject type changes in structural references.

findings.defect: Configuration I/O, parse or validation failures silently selected defaults.
findings.fix: Propagate the original error. Validate boundary options outside optional-COM deferral and STEP1/severity/rollback options before installation mutates bindings/state.

limitations: Offline regressions cover mocked preflight/baseline, TG/TD/SupplyMix transactions, accept/adopt/reject and rollback; they do not certify live COM/model execution.
